# Step - at_zone

`at_zone` · `atZone` · category: [Dates and times](../../traversal/step_reference.md#dates-and-times)

Places a date-time in a time zone.

## Forms

```text
at_zone(arg1: string)
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.inject(localdatetime("2023-08-02T12:00")).at_zone("+02:00").next().offset   // 7200
```
